scope: Specification of positive inputs and expected behavior, and unsupported negative requests. This JSON defines cases and is not an execution log. Direct MCP calls and the SDK demo verify tool behavior; the demo does not test assistant routing. Actual native assistant test evidence is retained in the native release records.

positive.prompt: Consulta la ficha pública de la referencia catastral 2749704YJ0624N y cita las fuentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available public parcel facts and official links. State the coverage of the descriptive lookup and coordinates separately. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI y distingue superficie construida y superficie de parcela, con unidades.
positive.expected_behavior: Report built and parcel area separately in m² when returned. Preserve the complete 20-character reference and cite the official source. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N y muestra la longitud, latitud y sistema de referencia de las coordenadas publicadas.
positive.expected_behavior: Label longitude, latitude and EPSG:4326 from the coordinate source. Describe the returned point without inferring a parcel boundary. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704yj0624n y muestra la referencia normalizada junto a los datos públicos disponibles.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the normalized uppercase reference 2749704YJ0624N and cite sources for returned facts. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI. Resume el uso y año de construcción si constan e indica qué información queda sin verificar.
positive.expected_behavior: Report cadastral use and construction year if present. Identify missing data or partial source failures and state that title and planning remain unverified. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

negative.prompt: Dime quién es el propietario y su NIF.
negative.expected_behavior: Owner identities and tax IDs are outside the public fact sheet. Explain the scope without collecting identifying information. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.

negative.prompt: Certifica que puedo construir en esta parcela.
negative.expected_behavior: Planning permission is a decision of the competent authority. Explain that a descriptive cadastral lookup cannot certify buildability. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.

A mortgage valuation is outside the cadastral lookup. Explain that the plugin returns public descriptive facts and cannot issue a valuation. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.
